title: Cottage cheese frittata with courgette and basil
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Thinly slice the courgette.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Fry the courgette in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 4 minutes, pour over the egg mixture and scatter the halved tomatoes on top.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until the frittata is set.
Sprinkle with basil, cut into wedges and serve with bread.
